question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘*viable*’ in the given sentence and choose the correct option.**

The engineer’s design was optimised for efficiency and scalability, with a focus on sustainability.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Sustainability**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word** 'viable' is 'sustainability'.**
 
• Let's look at the meaning of other options:
 
 
• **Efficiency** - कुशलता (Skillfulness, effectiveness)
 
• **Optimised** - सुधारित (Improved, enhanced)
 
• **Scalability** - मापनीयता (Ability to be resized or adapted according to demand)
 
• **Sustainability** - टिकाऊता (The ability to be maintained or continued) 
 
 
 
• The correct synonym for "**viable**" in the given sentence is **Sustainability**. "**Viable**" means capable of working successfully; in this context, it refers to the focus on sustainability, which means the ability to be maintained or continued.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4) Sustainability.**
